intended_object: In the Dold–Kan functor Γ₀, Γ₀(K)_n = ⊕_{[n]↠[k]} K_k. The definition is the summand at an index A, i.e. the surjection [n] ↠ [k], which is K_k. Inferred from the docstring and the module FunctorGamma.lean.
explanation: An index A : Splitting.IndexSet Δ is a pair: an object A.1 of SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ and an epimorphism Δ.unop ⟶ A.1.unop. So A.1.unop.len is the k of the target [k] of the surjection, and the body returns K.X k. This is exactly the summand in the standard Γ construction, and it matches the docstring. Nothing is narrowed: C is only assumed preadditive, and the indexing uses Mathlib's general Splitting.IndexSet. The definition is an auxiliary building block of Γ₀ rather than a standalone notion, so not_a_mathematical_object would also be defensible. It is judged faithful because the summand K_k at a surjection appears explicitly in the literature (e.g. Goerss–Jardine).
